Maruti Suzuki raises prices and sees weak demand for S‑Presso

Maruti Suzuki announced price hikes for several of its models, saying rising input costs were behind the increase, while its compact S‑Presso model is reported to be struggling to attract buyers and is far behind the Alto K10 in sales.
